hunks.baseline: “I put in more effort than you can imagine. And what I need from you now is not praise, but more detailed information. What connection does it have to my maternal grandfather's safety?”
hunks.sol: “I put in more effort than you might imagine. What I need now isn’t praise, though. I need details. What does Area A have to do with my maternal grandfather’s safety?”

hunks.baseline: “Because that person is there.”
hunks.sol: “He’s there.”

hunks.baseline: “That information is not certain.”
hunks.sol: “You can’t be certain of that.”

hunks.baseline: “Why do you think that?”
hunks.sol: “Why do you say that?”

hunks.baseline: “You were pushed out of the Ares Guild's inner circle long ago, Director Song.”
hunks.sol: “You were pushed out of the Ares Guild’s inner circle long ago, Regional Director.”

hunks.baseline: “……That hurts. But what you say is true. It is not certain information.”
hunks.sol: “……That stings. But you’re right. I can’t be certain.”

hunks.baseline: “I have also been unable to find any reason for my maternal grandfather to be there. No—I cannot understand it.”
hunks.sol: “I also can’t see why my maternal grandfather would be there. No—I can’t understand it.”

hunks.baseline: “A reason……”
hunks.sol: “Why…”

hunks.baseline: Song Cheonwoo let out a small sigh before continuing.
hunks.sol: Song sighed softly.
